key_insight: A simple winner-take-all LoRA merging strategy can consolidate multiple medical LVLM experts into one model and outperform more complex merging methods.
clinical_relevance: This could reduce the computational and operational burden of deploying many modality-specific medical imaging AI models while keeping broad task coverage.
method: Built MergeMedBench across 8 imaging modalities and diverse clinical task types.
Created 16 LoRA fine-tuned medical LVLM experts on two mainstream architectures.
Compared existing merge methods and proposed a hyperparameter-free winner-take-all merge that keeps dominant parameters.
evidence_signal: The paper reports an extensive benchmark evaluation across 16 expert models, with winner-take-all consistently outperforming prior merging approaches in the abstract.
watch_item: Results are benchmark-based and the approach still needs careful validation before use in real clinical workflows and across unseen hospital settings.
paper_title: Model Merging for Medical LVLMs: A Benchmark and a Winner-Take-All Approach
